## Potions, elixirs and scrolls (v0.7.5)

Potions and elixirs are drunk like milk (hold use). A **spell scroll** carries one spell from any grimoire up to level 10 (never Anti-Magic): read it to cast that spell at your own spell power - or at base power if you have no grimoire. A blank scroll (crafted or bought) settles on a random spell when you read it; scrolls found on elites and in lair chests already have their spell written on them. Reading ten counts for the **Scroll Scholar** feat.

| Item | Id | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Mana Potion | `bc:mana_potion` | Restores 60 mana (or 30% of the Anti-Magic gauge). |
| Greater Mana Potion | `bc:greater_mana_potion` | Restores all your mana and grants Regeneration for 10 s. |
| Elixir of Iron | `bc:elixir_iron` | Resistance II and Absorption II for 60 s. |
| Elixir of Haste | `bc:elixir_haste` | Speed and 25% shorter spell cooldowns for 60 s. |
| Smoke Bomb | `bc:smoke_bomb` | Blinds foes around you and hides you in smoke for 4 s. |
| Spell Scroll | `bc:spell_scroll` | Read it to cast the spell written on it - from any grimoire, even without one of your own. |
